title: Verify: keyboard flow and ARIA labels unit tests
summary: Unit tests for live region, labels, focus move and Escape.
description: Test the overlay a11y with the store seeded and the event bus spied.
acceptance_criteria: Live region, aria-labels, focus move and Escape asserted in one a11y test file
Enter on an action button calls onAction and Escape emits menuClose
technical_constraints: Fixtures come from runtime/content bedroom scene

steps.action: jsdom test: render ObjectOverlay for 'bookshelf'; assert role=status text contains the content name and action labels; assert each button aria-label equals `${label} ${name}`; with focus flag assert document.activeElement is the first button; userEvent Tab moves to the second button; press Enter on a button and assert onAction spy called; press Escape and assert phaserToReact.emit spy called with ('menuClose',{}).
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/objectOverlayA11y.test.tsx
